correctness.rationale: Given sample median Q(p), truncated lower/upper conditional means are H(p)/p and -H(p)/(1-p), H(p)=int_0^p Q. The affine regression yields (1-2p)H=2ap(1-p)Q after centering; symmetry forces the intercept. Differentiating gives a first-order quantile ODE whose symmetric solution is Q=constant*z*(1-z^2)^(1/(2a)-1). Positivity of its derivative on -1<z<1 forces a>=1/2 when a>0; for a<0 its endpoint power contradicts finite mean. Direct antiderivative verifies sufficiency. Independently checked regression identities at rational p and slopes, uniform a=1/2, Student-t2 a=1 and Pareto power index 2a/(2a-1). Boundary behavior is carefully restricted to parent regularity.
